changes: Donation discovery uses fixed-repository REST pull listing instead of an author Search qualifier. It filters the connected author locally and preserves owned job markers even when titles are edited.

Pagination is bounded, shape-checked and cancellation-aware. A partial, malformed or failed listing cannot authorize fresh inference or become an empty queue. Existing reservations, outbox payloads, consent and actual token receipts remain unchanged.
Chrome companion version detection accepts a validated common TAG-directive prologue while rejecting malformed prefixes and UTF-8 escapes. No YAML runtime dependency is added.
The mocked camera-capture fixture owns its raw-mode preference instead of borrowing the real animated-camera setting; production privacy guards are unchanged.
limits: Removing the reproduced discovery error does not establish the other PC account can create a fork, branch or pull request. Its full publishing result remains unverified.

REST listing is not a cross-PC atomic lease. Created-ascending pagination and duplicate detection do not guarantee a transaction during concurrent repository changes; local reservations retain their authority.
